claim: All facilities run on America/Chicago time.
truth: FAC3 runs America/Denver; FAC1 and FAC2 are America/Chicago.
check: Compare the hand-written profile (FACILITY_TZ) or watch FAC3 message timestamps against FAC1.

claim: Vital units are uniform across Riverbend: pounds, Fahrenheit, inches.
truth: FAC3 charts metric (kg, Cel, cm); FAC1 and FAC2 are imperial.
check: Compare the hand-written profile (VITAL_UNITS) per facility.

claim: AMOUNT on a charge line is an integer number of cents; it has always been cents.
truth: AMOUNT is dollars before 2012-01-01 and integer cents on/after it (the 2012 billing upgrade).
check: Compare the hand-written profile (CHARGE_CENTS_FROM) and charge amounts across the 2012 boundary.

claim: The CSV extract is the complete lab record; feed and extract carry the same results.
truth: Labs collected in the last 30 days before the export arrive only over the HL7 ORU feed and are absent from the LAB_RESULT extract.
check: Compare feed ORU results against the LAB_RESULT table for the 30 days before the export's as-of date.

claim: The dictionary excerpts IT circulates are current; when behaviour changed, the excerpt changed with it.
truth: The excerpts are stale on timezone, vital units, charges, and lab completeness (the estate_* entries above).

claim: HIM: all three facilities are on Central time. Interface engineering: FAC3 runs Mountain Time (America/Denver).
truth: FAC3 is America/Denver. The interface engineer is right; HIM is repeating the stale dictionary.
check: FAC3 message timestamps sit two hours behind the Central facilities.

claim: Dictionary: AMOUNT has always been cents. Interface engineering: the 2012 billing upgrade moved amounts to cents; before it, dollars.
truth: The cutover is 2012-01-01: dollars before, integer cents on/after.
check: Charge amount magnitudes across the 2012 boundary in a long export.
